the dynamic interaction of magnons in ferroelectro- magnetic materials with consideration of the effect of external magnetic and electric fields was studied using the diagram method.

the diagram method can be used to study the dynamic interaction in a ferroelectromagnet and the spectrum of coupled ferromagnetic waves in a ferroelectric antiferroelectric can be determined by considering the influence of external electric and magnetic fields.
the dynamic interaction in antiferromagnetically coupled ferroelectrics can be described by the diagram method.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the study of the influence of an electric field on the magnetic properties of antiferromagnetics, which are characterized by a high Curie temperature, and vice versa, the influence of a magnetic field on the dielectric properties of antiferroelectrics.

the study of the interaction between ferroelectric and antiferromagnetic order parameters, which is a subject of great interest in the study of the phase transitions in multiferroic materials, and in particular, in the study of multiferroic behavior in rare-earth manganites and ferrites.

the study of the dynamic interaction of magnons and phonons in the ferroelectric and ferromagnetic phase of antiferroelectric-antiferromagnetic crystals with the consideration of the influence on them of the external constant magnetic field and electric field.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the diagram method is a useful tool for the study of the dynamic interaction of ferroelectromagnetism.
, the study of the dynamic interaction of ferroelectromagnetism in antiferroelectromagnetics with consideration of the external field is very important.

the present study has provided the first direct experimental evidence that the magnetic field induced by a spin current in the ferromagnet is the source of the spin torque acting on the magnetization in the ferromagnetic free layer of the MTJ.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the method used in the present paper allows one to find the spectrum of the coupled ferroelectro-magnon waves in antiferromagnetics and ferroelectrics with arbitrary symmetry.

we have found the spectrum of coupled magneto—piezoelectric waves in ferroelectric—ferromagnets of the cubic class and the spectrum of coupled piezomagnetic—piezoelectromagnetic waves in ferromagnetic—antiferroelectric of the tetragonal class.

we found the spectrum of coupled ferromagneto-electric waves in antiferromagnetics of arbitrary symmetry, taking into account external constant fields, and the magnon—magnetoplastic interaction contribution to the free energy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the diagram method is an effective tool for studying the dynamics of ferroelectromagnet systems.
the diagram method can be used to study the dynamic interaction of ferroelectromagnet waves in crystals with arbitrary crystal symmetry.
the diagram method allows one to take into account the influence on the spectrum of the interaction of magnons with phonons, electrons, and other excitations.
